patthana16.87:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭiccaะ na anidassanaappaṭigho na upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: …pe… anidassanaappaṭighaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na upekkhāsahagato ca na anidassanasappaṭigho na upekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana16.87:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ naupekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika kāmāvacaraduke nasanidassanattika nakāmāvacaradukaṃ
